name: Tanizaki Jirou
source:
"Umm... you've been working hard today as well."

A popular landscape painter. He always dresses, speaks, and acts like a women. Because of his high-pitched voice, only few people recognize him as man.

There is always a sense of insecurity in his heart due to his lack of self-confidence, hence why he has a psychiatrist.

He goes to the cafe as part of Mori's counseling and treatment.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/irohanihoheto/%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9-1]offiical website[/url]]
